summary:
Summary:
TASK-004 passes QA. The app now has a hero header and a photo-card gallery that shows 12 peaks per page. It uses local images and route data from data/peak-media.json (looked up by peak id), and none of that data is hard-coded in the UI. data/peaks.json and data/peak-media.json are unchanged (`git diff` shows nothing for data/). No external CSS/JS frameworks or web fonts were added: no CDN, @import or @font-face references in the CSS, and package.json has no runtime dependencies. The page-switching logic and the HTML for cards, the details photo and the route section are pure, unit-tested functions in src/peak-utils.js. Both test suites pass at desktop and 360px mobile sizes. All 12 acceptance criteria are met.

Issues:
- None

Tests:
- `npm test`: 121 of 121 unit tests passed, so the suite is not empty. They cover pagination (page count, clamping out-of-range pages, slicing the first, middle and last pages, an empty list), the pagination controls (one aria-current="page" button, Previous/Next disabled at the ends), card photo rendering (lazy loading, alt text, fixed aspect ratio in CSS), the details photo (credit, licence link, source link), and the route section with and without a route. They also check new-tab links use rel="noopener noreferrer", that image and route URLs aren't hard-coded, and that no external frameworks or fonts were added.
- `npm run test:e2e` (Playwright, desktop and 360px mobile): 58 of 58 passed, none skipped. The route and no-route dialog tests both ran, because the data has peaks of each kind.
- Pagination (Playwright): 12 cards per page; Previous, Next and numbered buttons show the right peaks; keyboard focus moves to the gallery heading after changing page; it works with the keyboard; changing a filter returns to page 1 and the page count matches the filtered results; Reset Filters restores the full list.
- Photo cards (Playwright): images are lazy-loaded, have the alt text and src from the media data, actually load, and keep a 4:3 frame. Each card shows the number, name, region, height and completion state, and marking a peak complete updates the card.
- Details dialog (Playwright): shows the large photo with credit, licence link and source link. For a peak with a route it shows the route title and source, a route page link, a Download GPX link and the Garmin Connect steps. Every link opens in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer". For a peak without a route it shows the "not available yet" message with no links.
- Responsive layout (Playwright): 1 column at 360px with no horizontal scrolling and pagination buttons at least 44px tall; at least 3 columns at 1280px; the details dialog fits the screen.
- Existing features (Playwright): all 100 peaks are reachable across pages; overall and region progress update; marking and unmarking works from cards and from the dialog, including on later pages; progress is still there after a reload; filters work; the dialog keeps focus inside it, closes with Escape or the Close button, and returns focus to the button that opened it.
- Code review: tests/e2e/screenshots.spec.js now captures the gallery (pages 1 and 2) and a details dialog with a route. src/server.js was only changed to add image content types (.jpg, .jpeg, .webp).
